title: According to whom? Reporting a source

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know reporting statements and citing a source with *según* from B1 Unit 13, together with *decir que*, *explicar que* and *informar de que*. In a disputed period like the 1980s, naming who says what keeps facts apart from judgements.

items.spanish: Según la CEPAL, los años ochenta fueron una década perdida.
items.english: According to CEPAL, the 1980s were a lost decade.

items.spanish: Según muchos economistas, el Plan Baker tuvo pocos resultados.
items.english: According to many economists, the Baker Plan had few results.

items.spanish: Los defensores del ajuste dicen que era necesario.
items.english: The supporters of adjustment say that it was necessary.

items.spanish: Los críticos explican que lo pagaron sobre todo las familias pobres.
items.english: The critics explain that poor families paid most of it.

sections.content: Put *según* before the source, with no *que*: *según la CEPAL*, not *según que*. After a verb of saying, use *que*: *dicen que*, *explican que*. Use these expressions to separate what a source claims from your own opinion.
